## Morphix 1.11.0 — Compress videos to any size, every tool one click away 🎬

Every file tool you need — one shortcut away. PDF, images, Office, audio & video, OCR and offline speech-to-text.

### Download
- **Windows:** `Morphix_Windows_1.11.0.zip` — unzip it and run `Morphix.exe` (keep it together with the `_internal` folder).
- **macOS (Apple Silicon):** `Morphix_macOS_1.11.0.dmg` — open it and drag Morphix into Applications. The first time, right-click Morphix → **Open**. On macOS 15 or later, if it says Morphix was "Not Opened", go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, scroll down and click **Open Anyway**.
- **Linux (x86_64):** `Morphix-1.11.0-x86_64.AppImage` — make it executable (right-click → Properties → *Allow executing file as program*, or `chmod +x`) and double-click it.

### What's new
- **Compress videos and audio** — one file or many. Pick **Recommended** for the best balance, set the **strength** yourself, or choose a **target size** like 25 MB and every file ends up under it, however big it was (handy for WhatsApp, email and upload forms). While you adjust, Morphix tells you what to expect: excellent, good, acceptable, low or very poor quality, with the estimated size of each file. Your originals are never changed.
- **All tools** — a new tile in the Action Hub shows every tool for the files you selected, grouped and searchable. Click a tool to run it, or tap ★ to pin it to the hub (or remove it).
- **Show all tools** — turn it on and the hub shows every tool, in every shape, each time you press the shortcut. The wheel becomes two rings; the square, rectangle and bar grow to fit.

### Also in 1.10
- Scan documents into clean PDFs, send photos, videos and files from your phone over Wi-Fi, and make or read QR codes.

### Good to know
- **iPhone:** to send originals (HEIC photos, full-size videos), tap **Options** (iOS 17) or **⚙︎** (iOS 18+) in the photo picker and set **Format** to **Current** — otherwise iOS converts photos to JPG and shrinks videos before sending. The page on your phone shows this tip.
- For **From my phone**, the phone and the computer must be on the same Wi-Fi (guest networks usually block this). The first time, your computer may ask whether Morphix can accept incoming connections — choose **Allow**.
- Everything still runs on your own computer. Your files never go to any server.

> These builds are not digitally signed. Windows may show a SmartScreen warning (**More info → Run anyway**), and Smart App Control may block the app if it is turned on.
